description: A dramatic open-plan kitchen and dining room with an industrial-modern character. The ceiling is raw dark concrete with exposed ductwork and structural elements, painted or finished in matte charcoal grey. Floor-to-ceiling heavy grey linen curtain panels line the right wall, framing a tall casement window that looks out onto an urban street view. The dining zone features a massive live-edge solid walnut slab table on a matte black steel base, surrounded by five contemporary moulded grey fabric swivel chairs with spider bases. A shallow decorative wood bowl holds dried white botanicals as the sole table centerpiece. The open kitchen along the left wall features walnut grain lower cabinets with a wine bottle rack section, dark grey concrete-look tile backsplash and walls, floating walnut open shelves with slim profile, and stainless steel appliances. The floor is large-format light grey porcelain tile. Cool blue-white daylight floods through the window. Bright linear white light emanates from the hanging installation above the dining table, creating striking illuminated geometric branches that cast cool direct light onto the table surface and warm ambient fill into the surrounding space. The mood is bold, architectural, and moody-industrial. Camera at standing eye-level, off-center thirds composition angled toward the kitchen end, wide lens, level pitch, wide establishing view showing both kitchen and dining areas. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
